extracted.name: Chicken Tenders
extracted.description: My grandkids love these when they come over
instruction_lines: Rinse and, season chicken tenders on both sides.
Add canola oil to a skillet and, let heat while oil is heating add the eggs to a bowl, and flour to a bowl.
Dip seasoned chicken to flour, egg, back to flour once you've coated the chicken lay in hot oil, cook for 15 min or, till reach 160 degrees enjoy.
